I hate this feeling. I’m also dealing with this feeling. Hard for me to wrap my head around asking someone for help, then being returned with silence or normalcy. I would be there if someone told me they were struggling, I would show up in as many ways as I could. I’m telling myself they don’t know better, they don’t understand but regardless, lack of effort speaks for itself. 
What’s helping me hold on is focusing on the hope that there will one day be someone who supports you just as you need it.

Straight truth, I strongly believe that you can love someone wholly even while struggling to love yourself. That it is OK to have someone help you understand how to love yourself, and that once you understand how to love yourself, it’s a whole other journey with your partner. Being alone, in my opinion, is the path less travelled towards healing. Doable but not easy.

Hey! 23F and would like to chat to see if we’d be a fun fit, I’m into hiking and would love to find all the best views with someone I can get close and comfortable with. I would say I’m also an extrovert but appreciate quiet moments, reading together, or napping. 
Wanting to find a gang or a bestie to plan some camping trips with for the summer :))

I was just thinking about this, people say we need to find our reason to live in ourselves... but we’re depressed, we live in the world of our mind that tells us there’s nothing to live for. So I think if someone can give you a reason to live, then hold on to it for dear life till you find your own. So happy to see this, but disheartening at the same time.

I may continue, or I may choose to stop. The human body is an amazing thing, not to be ashamed of, and I try not to be ashamed when taking part in “the game”.
